specs: Standard Passenger: Those weighing up to 259lbs fully clothed.
Standard Plus Passenger: Those weighing 260-299lbs fully clothed.
Premium Passenger: Those weighing 300lb or more fully clothed.
Flight Minimums In order to conduct our tours, a minimum of 4 passengers must be met.
This EXCLUSIVE tour accommodates up to six guests per departure (up to 1,240 lbs combined passenger weights).
Weight Restrictions Persons weighing 260 pounds (clothed weight) or more must pay for an additional seat.
Cancellations must be confirmed via e-mail or phone with a Coastal employee.
If a family/party member is ill on the day of the tour, medical documentation must be provided for a refund, and any passengers that stay behind with them will not be eligible for a refund.
DOCUMENTATION FOR REFUNDS MUST BE PROVIDED WITHIN TWO WEEKS AFTER THE DATE OF THE TOUR, OR YOU WILL BE INELIGIBLE FOR A REFUND.

services.name: Annual Fundraising Event - Christmas Light Flights 2025
services.desc: Take a quick flight at night to look at all the Christmas lights in the Valley! Coastal's annual Christmas Light Flights Fundraiser is set for December 15th. All proceeds will be donated to The Mendenhall Flying Lions Club and Cancer Connection. Location and Check-in: The time you book is your check-in time.
